data.body:
[P2] Match completed receipts independently of array order

The shared iterator makes receipt matching order-dependent. For partial receipts `[A, B]` from different requests and completed receipts `[B, A]` with matching identities, searching for A consumes B, which is then incorrectly reported missing. Cross-request array order is not an evidence identity, so this rejects valid cleanup and quarantines the profile solely because a collector reordered records. Use one-to-one identity matching independent of array position, preserving multiplicity, and add a regression with reordered completed receipts.
